sections.title: Agentic AI & GenAI
sections.subtitle: Knowledge that answers. Agents that act.

sections.heading: From AI ideas to everyday enterprise work
sections.body:
From AI strategy to agentic AI in production: turn data into decisions, governed from day one. We help organisations develop autonomous agents that act within defined boundaries and GenAI knowledge assistants grounded in their own data.

Build on the foundations of intelligent document analytics, enterprise search and conversational platforms. Connect useful answers with the processes where they can make a difference, while keeping human oversight, evaluation and access in view.

sections.heading: Answers and actions, grounded in your business

sections.heading: A practical route to production AI
sections.description: Define the business task first. Then bring the right data, evaluation and operational controls around the assistant or agent.

items.title: Select the use case
items.description: Identify the work to improve, the users involved and how success will be assessed. Agree which actions remain with people.

items.title: Ground the experience
items.description: Review source material, data access and tool boundaries. Design retrieval and responses around the information the intended users may access.

items.title: Evaluate before release
items.description: Test representative questions and tasks. Review output quality, agent actions and failure scenarios against agreed acceptance criteria.

items.title: Observe and improve
items.description: Introduce the solution with guardrails, cost visibility and operational ownership. Use feedback and tracing to guide subsequent improvements.
